SYNTHETIC COMMERCIAL MUTUAL NDA - NOT FOR EXECUTION
1. Purpose. Each Recipient shall use Confidential Information only to evaluate the proposed business relationship between the parties.
2. Confidentiality. Each Recipient must keep the Confidential Information confidential for 24 months after disclosure.
3. Return. Upon the Discloser's written request, the Recipient must return or destroy the Confidential Information within 20 calendar days after the request.
4. Compelled Disclosure. If disclosure is legally compelled, the Recipient must give prior written notice to the Discloser to the extent legally permitted.
5. Residuals. Neither Recipient may use residual information retained in unaided memory.
6. Assignment. Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent.
7. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of Ontario, Canada.
8. Representatives. The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to representatives only on a need-to-know basis and remains responsible for their breaches of this Agreement.
